name: HalfLifeBSP
author: Elintria
description: Loads Half-Life 1 maps (.bsp) into Elintria scenes: brush geometry with lightmaps, WAD textures, monsters and items with their animations, sounds and sentences, AI node graphs, triggers, doors, trains, scripted sequences and multi_managers that run in Play mode, and level changes behind a loading screen. Adds the BSPLoader window and detailed gizmos for entity connections.
